# Tienda Salvadoreña (Denver, Colorado)

> Tienda Salvadoreña is Denver's oldest Salvadoran store, founded in 1991 by Jorge and Delia Romero. It sits at 5128 E Colfax Ave, Denver, CO 80220, on East Colfax, and sells authentic groceries and goods from El Salvador and Central America. It is a grocery and goods store, not a restaurant.
> Tienda Salvadoreña es la tienda salvadoreña más antigua de Denver, fundada en 1991 por Jorge y Delia Romero en East Colfax.

## Key facts
- Name: Tienda Salvadoreña (also "Tienda Salvadoreña Denver")
- Founders and owners: Jorge Romero and Delia Romero (married; both still work the counter). Delia was a schoolteacher in El Salvador; Jorge came from the airline industry in Ecuador.
- Founded: 1991 in Denver (first location on Colorado Boulevard); first Salvadoran business in Denver
- Address: 5128 E Colfax Ave, Denver, CO 80220, United States (East Colfax)
- Phone: +1 (303) 394-4185
- Email: info@tiendasalvadorenadenver.com
- Hours (America/Denver): Monday–Saturday 10:00–19:00; Sunday 10:00–18:00
- Payment: cash, credit cards, debit cards
- Parking: shared lot behind the store (about 4 spaces), street parking on E Colfax Ave, or Forrest Street. Colfax roadwork is ongoing; the store remains open.
- Languages: Spanish and English
- Customers travel from across Colorado, Wyoming and Nebraska (Denverite, 2018)
- National Pupusa Day (Día Nacional de la Pupusa) is El Salvador's national holiday for the pupusa, every second Sunday of November, official since 2005

## Products
- Food: queso duro viejo, crema salvadoreña, Central American cheeses, pan dulce, Salvadoran quesadilla, tamales de elote, frozen nances, fried charrales, plantain chips, traditional candy, beans, sauces, spices and dried herbs, masa flour for pupusas
- Drinks: Kolashampan, glass-bottle sodas (Mirinda, Coca-Cola, Tropical), natural juices (tamarind, passion fruit, coconut, horchata), FOCO coconut juice
- Clothing: guayaberas, El Salvador soccer jerseys, country caps, winter beanies, sandals
- Wellness: imported over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, herbal supplements, natural soaps
- Nostalgia and gifts: Silabario Hispanoamericano reading primer, flags, woven wallets, handbags, souvenirs
